headline: Berkshire Hathaway reports earnings beat and increased share buybacks
summary: Berkshire Hathaway reported quarterly earnings that exceeded analyst estimates, despite a decline in operating profit. The company responded by accelerating its share repurchase program.
why: Berkshire Hathaway is a major conglomerate led by Warren Buffett, serving as a bellwether for the broader U.S. economy and corporate sentiment.

impacts.name: Berkshire Hathaway
impacts.why: Earnings beat and increased buybacks typically signal management confidence and support share prices.
